claims.answer: Desktop supports macOS arm64; Linux x64 and Windows x64 installers are alpha. iOS TestFlight and Android APK clients connect to a bb server. The server serves a local or remote browser app for live thread inspection and steering. Phones and tablets can use a remote browser without the optional local editor helper. The bundled bb CLI can be installed on PATH or run through npm. Threads can be followed live, steered and handed off through the app, CLI or API. The push-notifications plugin notifies registered phones and open web and desktop clients; phone push needs the server to reach exp.host through bb connect or an HTTPS profile.
